description: Select the UI action you would like to execute. The UI action will run in its entirety (client and server side).
label: UI action
name: uiAction

description: If true, any UI action redirects will open the record within a modeless dialog. Otherwise, the record will open as a full page.
label: Open in dialog
name: openInDialog

description: Specify a form view to display when the form is shown in a modeless dialog. Leave blank to use a form view defined in the UI Action.
label: Override form view in dialog
name: dialogFormView
